2607.13241.title: EMAGN: Efficient Multi-Attention Graph Network via Learned Clustering for Scalable Traffic Forecasting
2607.13241.paper_summary: Traffic forecasting is highly challenging due to complex and nonlinear spatial and temporal dependencies. Self-attention mechanisms have been widely adopted to model dynamic and long-range dependencies, achieving state-of-the-art performance, but suffer from limited scalability due to quadratic computational and memory complexity. To address this, we propose an Efficient Multi-Attention Graph Network (EMAGN) that linearises the spatial attention mechanism itself, inspired by the theory of fast high-dimensional Gaussian filtering. Two learned clustering matrices C_k and C_v adaptively group key and value vectors into M super-clusters, reducing complexity from O(N^2 d) to O(NMd) without sacrificing the flexibility of attention for dynamic dependency modelling. Experimental results on PEMS-BAY and METR-LA show that EMAGN achieves accuracy within 2.7-3.2% MAE of full-attention GMAN while reducing training time by 32%, inference time by 38%, and GPU memory by 58%. Critically, at K=16 attention heads, full-attention GMAN runs out of memory on a standard 11 GB GPU entirely while EMAGN continues to operate, demonstrating a categorical expansion of feasible model configurations. EMAGN also surpasses Linformer and Performer in both accuracy and efficiency within the same backbone, owing to its traffic-network-aware adaptive clustering.
2607.13241.paper_summary_zh: 交通預測因為複雜和非線性的空間及時間依賴性而極具挑戰性。自注意力機制已被廣泛採用來建模動態和長距依賴性，達到最先進的表現，但由於二次計算和記憶體複雜度，擴展性受到限制。為了解決這個問題，我們提出了一種高效的多重注意力圖網絡（EMAGN），該網絡通過快速高維高斯濾波理論的啟發，對空間注意力機制本身進行線性化。兩個學習的聚類矩陣 C_k 和 C_v 自適應地將關鍵向量和數值向量分組成 M 個超聚類，將複雜度從 O(N^2 d) 降低到 O(NMd)，而不犧牲動態依賴建模的注意力靈活性。在 PEMS-BAY 和 METR-LA 上的實驗結果顯示，EMAGN 在準確度上達到了全注意力 GMAN 的 2.7-3.2% MAE，同時將訓練時間減少了 32%，推理時間減少了 38%，GPU 記憶體減少了 58%。關鍵是，當 K=16 注意力頭時，全注意力 GMAN 在標準的 11 GB GPU 上完全耗盡記憶體，而 EMAGN 仍然能夠運行，顯示出可行模型配置的類別擴展。EMAGN 在同一骨幹下的準確性和效率上也超越了 Linformer 和 Performer，這要歸功於其對交通網絡的自適應聚類。
